purpose: Interactive workflow for writing a draft requirements document first and refining it through dialogue when no Figma or screen design exists, for new apps or feature additions.
summary: Required reading list including additive development spec and frontmatter format
Phase 0: confirm what is known from prior discussion and determine whether the work is completely new
Phase 1: fetch rules and existing assets, optional external research
Phase 2: confirm vision, value, scope, and out-of-scope items
Phase 3: classify pure-additive versus differential type with approval, decide placement, number IDs, write draft with doc_status draft
Phase 4: discuss draft, scenarios, screen lists, glossary, bottom-up exploration order, create requirements, re-judge type and add temporary marker
Phase 5: quality checks, TBD organization, AI review, remove draft status, specs index update, commit, completion guidance
Basic dialogue principles: visual confirmation, tolerating TBD, focus on What, staged presentation, scope control, no history sections, consistency check
Anti-patterns table and special rules for ambiguity handled as TBD, with review severity matrix
Question templates and deliverables list per phase
tasks: Creating requirements without Figma or screen designs
Starting a new app from scratch
Adding a new feature to an existing app
Judging pure-additive versus differential development type
Drafting requirements and refining through discussion
Reviewing requirements with TBD and ambiguity rules
Building a glossary and exploring system architecture
title: 対話型要件定義ワークフロー
